outline: 微分方程式概論與應用，矩陣及線性方程式，行列式，向量空間，基底，線性轉換，正交空間，傅立葉轉換，傅立葉積分。
schedule:
第一週   First Order Differential Equations, Preliminary Concepts, Separable Equations
第二週   Linear, Exact Differential Equations and Integrating Factors
第三週   Homogeneous, Bernoulli, Reccati Equations and Applications of Electrical Circuits
第四週   Second Order Differential Equations, Preliminary Concepts, and Reduction of Order
第五週   The Constant Coefficient Homogeneous Linear Equations and Euler Equations,
第六週   The Nonhomogeneous Equation and Applications of Electrical Circuits
第七週   The Laplace Transform, Definition and Properties and Solution of Initial Value Problems
第八週   Shifting Theorems, Convolution Theorem, Unit Impulses and the Dirac Delta Function
第九週   Laplace Transform Solution of Systems, Differential Equations with Polynomial Coefficients and Midterm Exam
第十週   Fourier Series, the Fourier Series of a Function and Convergence of Fourier Series
第十一週 Fourier Cosine and Sine Series
第十二週 Integration and Differentiation of Fourier Series and the Phase Angle Form of a Fourier Series
第十三週 Complex Fourier Series and the Frequency Spectrum
第十四週 The Fourier Integral and Fourier Transforms and the Fourier Integral
第十五週 Fourier Cosine, Sine Integrals, the Complex Fourier Integral and the Fourier Transform
第十六週 Additional Properties and Applications of the Fourier Transform
第十七週 The Finite Fourier Cosine and Sine Transforms
第十八週 Final Exam.
